description: This file is a shell script for testing Git operations and diff behaviors. It sets up a series of tests using git commands to verify the behavior of diffs under various conditions, including checking exit codes, handling of binary files, conflicts, and submodules.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects a command to succeed and checks its output against a description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion for cleanup.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository, likely a helper for setting up subrepos.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes in the repository, possibly with a specific message or context.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment's timestamp or state, used for reproducible commits.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the series of tests.
